هر مقاله‌ای که تولید شده اینجا منتظر تصم: Every generated article waits here for your decision. “Passed the gate” means a WordPress draft exists and only needs human approval; “below the gate” means the quality score fell short and no draft was created. Approving only marks the version as publishable — the final publish always happens in WordPress itself, and AUTO PUBLISH is always off (§73).

Usually the model is too weak or does not support JSON output — pick a stronger one, such as gpt-4o, claude-sonnet or gemini-1.5-pro.
